events.text: CP All set its GHG emissions reduction target aligned with Thailand's national target, which pledged a 20-25% GHG emissions reduction by 2030 after Thailand ratified the Paris Agreement on September 21, 2016.
CP ALL PCL submitted a net-zero greenhouse gas emissions target to SBTi for validation.
CP ALL PCL reports progress toward carbon neutrality by 2030 and net zero by 2050 in its 2024 Sustainability Report.
CP ALL PCL's 2024 Sustainability Report follows GRI Standards and includes an independent LRQA assurance statement.
CP ALL PCL's 2025 Sustainability Report, under its '3 Creates, 2 Reductions' strategy, aims to achieve carbon neutrality by 2030 and net-zero emissions by 2050.
CP ALL PCL's carbon neutrality and net-zero targets were validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi).
